title: Reproducing a score is not proof of human benefit: auditing 27 ManagerBench metrics
description: Independent audit of 27 saved prediction metrics; no claim of field efficacy.
markdown:
# Reproducing a score is not proof of human benefit: auditing 27 ManagerBench metrics

**TL;DR.** We independently recomputed 27 metrics from nine sets of saved predictions on 256 purchase-intention cases. All matched within 1e-8. Calibrated public Manager v0 (Brier .123713) did not beat logistic regression (.120993) in point estimates. This is neither new inference nor an intervention trial.

![Research cover](/assets/research/manager-research-evidence-2026-11-26-cover.svg)

## Problem
A downloadable model, reproducible metric and a beneficial intervention are three different claims. Before writing our paper, we checked whether recorded prediction scores can be independently reproduced.

## How we did it
The [UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention dataset](https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F88Q) is CC BY 4.0. The shared exploratory test has 256 cases, 37 positives; Pilot005 used 256 training and 128 calibration cases. Earlier internal splits are disjoint, but wider team/pretraining overlap is unknown. Public v0 was actually loaded in Chapter18 at revision 757102ac1e0f9d2eff7f42bb45c249e4aedee744. This audit uses saved probabilities only, independently implements mean squared probability error, negative log likelihood, and positive-negative rank comparison with half credit for ties using standard Python.

```bash
# anicca-ops pinned commit 7f786bb6c1ade02856883431823efb902e1ca579
python3 files/research-artifacts/paper-ch22-2026-11-26/audit.py
``
Output: n=256, positive=37, verified_metrics=27. The original receipt hash also matched.

## Results
![Brier comparison](/assets/research/manager-research-evidence-2026-11-26-chart.svg)
Figure 1. Independently recalculated saved predictions on 256 real purchase-intention records. Lower Brier is better.

| Model | Brier ↓ | NLL ↓ | AUROC ↑ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Logistic | .120993 | .399619 | .631618 |
| Calibration prior | .123779 | .413686 | .500000 |
| Public Manager v0 calibrated | .123713 | .413395 | .543256 |
| SmolLM2 base calibrated | .123954 | .414290 | .636925 |
| Pilot005 calibrated | .124327 | .416064 | .397877 |

Public v0 minus logistic Brier is +.002720; the existing paired bootstrap interval is [-.006528,.012727]. Superiority is not established. Reduced answer-order sensitivity does not guarantee improved discrimination. Keep negative results.

## Where the product enters
![Evidence pipeline](/assets/research/manager-research-evidence-2026-11-26-pipeline.svg)
Figure 2. Recomputing predictions does not establish field benefit. Existing backend fixtures exported three synthetic assignments; the causal intake accepted zero. Assignment, delivery, exposure, outcomes and burden need separate evidence.

## Limitations and next step
This is the same exploratory split, not a fresh blinded holdout. Human benefit and Graduation remain unmeasured. Public v0 failed the intervention gate and is not promoted. Next: rights-cleared independent external comparisons and validated consent/outcome contracts in the product.
